title: Certify a tiny conditional T740 kappa rounding-slack refinement
body:
This adds a positive-binomial interval certificate for a **tiny rounding-slack refinement** of the unchanged coupled T740 construction. Relative to dataisfire's PR3361 at `f9de2024916a347d939ed256a7a2e9e68d633684`, the conditional multiplication saving increases by approximately `3.609e-36` to

```
kappa = 0.001729777494678597011886903656817803609 - 10^-62 - 10^-86.
```

The endpoint was already inside PR3361's published root bracket. The contribution is a separately implemented integer-only generalized-binomial enclosure and a finer exact outer release. The binomial technique already appears in earlier repository audits; those precedents are credited, and no method priority is claimed. It is not a cheaper circuit, a runtime speedup, or a selected-frontier update. Three bounded circuit searches found no paid-profile gain; their scopes and reproducible local artifact hashes are recorded.

The supplier remains Jeremy Diviney's PR3148 at `f2927a4b8afcf0701a6b945e14f30de1d94f5176`, on dcharb78's PR3133 at `51eb9c4ee9e4722010d308aa3309e039d3940cc2`. PR3148 and PR3361 are now archived on main, with archive acceptance distinct from mathematical validation. Neither is the selected record. Source manifests, prior claim, attribution and notices are preserved. All-size/compiler, physical common-label and mutable-source realization, whole-call hosting, precision/tape, recovery, analytic transfer and BIT H1-H5 remain conditional. Finite success is not formal verification of the complete multiplication theorem.

Validation: three exact moment engines, 63 modern outer inequalities and 17 controls, 47 bootstrap rows and four controls, unchanged supplier receipt checks and ten controls. The new engine has 288 exact square-root calibrations, 288 zero-power checks, omitted-tail/domain faults and actual CLI claim/result/source/optimization controls. Registered Python 3.12 replay and a complete committed Git-free export pass. Exact commands, rational comparison and log hashes are in `VALIDATION.json`.

The fresh T740 run rebuilt the retained bootstrap and both native providers, then hit the unchanged controller’s 3,600-second timeout during complete admission. Its unchanged full release verifier subsequently passed in a fresh output directory using that authenticated fresh native cache. Pre/post source, cache and external-input hashes, literal allocation, complete finite admission, modern outer release and exact original supplier κ all bind. The original timeout remains recorded; no synthetic controller PASS is claimed. Commands and receipts are in `COLD-REPLAY.md` and `VALIDATION.json`. The complete selected-main incremental target `make frontier1094-verify` passed with exit 0.

`make verify` was run on untouched canonical main at both `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c` and `714606601d4aae7fbe8cf0c9727b59ba754bc02e` and fails at the historical `copied-fixed-reversed-producer` target: `scripts/partial_swap/shared.py` unpacks a singleton retained-total target into three names. No checker or expected result was changed to hide that failure. Final main `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90` changes none of the candidate’s declared inputs, selected record, Makefile or scripts relative to that tested checkpoint.

Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance is disclosed. Published by SovereignSteak; no maintainer acceptance or priority over the credited construction is claimed.

Final submitted scientific/export check: `550a660a97308d3aeb3620ee1f4218f77e2c2742`; registered replay and complete Git-free export replay pass with unchanged exported bytes.
